og.title: Recurring Billing & Contract Management Software India | Effortless
og.description: Automate AMC billing and recurring invoices. Create once, bill forever. WhatsApp reminders, Tally sync, and revenue forecasting — built for India.

acceptedAnswer.text: Effortless Contracts automates recurring billing for AMCs, rentals, and retainers. Create a contract once and Effortless generates invoices, sends WhatsApp reminders, and syncs to Tally automatically.
Yes. Effortless supports both Proforma-first and Invoice-first recurring billing modes, with automated delivery via WhatsApp and email.

serviceContent.title: Two Modes.
serviceContent.description: Choose the billing workflow that fits your business

billingModesData.title: Proforma First (Tax Safe)
steps: Send Proforma with Payment link or QR
billingModesData.whyText: Use when you want to avoid early GST liability. Proforma goes first, payment clears, invoice is created instantly.

billingModesData.title: Invoice First (Fully Automatic)
steps: Auto-Generate GST Invoice with Payment Link or QR
billingModesData.whyText: For fixed retainers and trusted clients where the invoice should fire on the exact date without manual work.

serviceContent.title: Feature
serviceContent.description: Seven powerful features that make recurring revenue effortless

salesFeature.subtitle: Once for All
salesFeature.title: Create Once. Bill Forever.
description: Set frequency, duration, service start date, billing date, billing mode and payment mode once. Effortless builds every cycle automatically—no calendar reminders, no spreadsheets.

salesFeature.subtitle: Autopilot
salesFeature.title: Smart Reminders
description: WhatsApp + Email reminders fire automatically. No manual follow-ups, no missed renewals.

salesFeature.subtitle: Multi Choice
salesFeature.title: Two Billing Styles, One System
description: Choose Proforma-first or Invoice-first. Both run smoothly in the same dashboard.

salesFeature.subtitle: Multi GSTIN
salesFeature.title: Multi-Branch Visibility
description: Assign each contract to the correct GSTN or branch. HQ gets a consolidated view, branches see only their data.

salesFeature.subtitle: Weather Forecast
salesFeature.title: Forecast in One Screen
description: Know your upcoming renewals, overdue contracts, expected cash, and customer history in seconds.

salesFeature.subtitle: The Final Truth Remains True
salesFeature.title: Tally Sync That Just Works
description: Invoices, Proformas, Payments — everything flows into Tally post approvals without conflict. No duplicate voucher numbers. No mismatches.

salesFeature.subtitle: Mr Predictable
salesFeature.title: Cash Flow That Follows Your Billing
description: When billing becomes predictable, monthly inflow becomes predictable too.
Now your contracts run on autopilot.
